#  35431 - Electrical Distribution Systems 1 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **35431 - module is no longer offered from WS 2012/13**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Electrical Distribution Systems 1**  |  
|  Systeme der elektrischen Energieverteilung 1   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr.-Ing. Pfeiffer, Klaus 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will get a deeper understanding in rating of electrical equipment and calculation of the relevant thermal and dynamic stresses. The lecture finishes with a short project work, which includes s.c.-calculation, cable selection and rating of switchgears.  |  
| Contents:  | Low- and medium-voltage cables, cable selection, transformers, switchgears and substations, circuit breaker  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | Knowledges:
  * Module _Introduction in Electrical Power Systems_ (35421)

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 75 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Script  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 1 written examinations, 90 min  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | Electrical Distribution Systems 1 (lecture/exercise)  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
